annotations.exact_quote: We observe that this simple constraint on the features greatly enhances the robustness of learned models, even against the strongest white-box attacks, without degrading the classification performance on clean images.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文研究对抗攻击下的防御，并报告所提特征约束增强模型在白盒攻击下的鲁棒性，符合对抗鲁棒性定义。
